name: ShadowFormat
description: Represents shadow formatting for a shape.
remarks: Use the Shadow property to return a ShadowFormat object. The following example adds a shadowed rectangle to the active document. The semitransparent, blue shadow is offset 5 points to the right of the rectangle and 3 points above it.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified ShadowFormat object.

properties.name: ForeColor
properties.description: Returns or sets a ColorFormat object that represents the foreground color for the fill, line, or shadow. Read/write.

properties.name: Obscured
properties.description: MsoTrue if the shadow of the specified shape appears filled in and is obscured by the shape, even if the shape has no fill. MsoFalse if the shadow has no fill and the outline of the shadow is visible through the shape if the shape has no fill. Read/write MsoTriState.

properties.name: OffsetX
properties.description: Returns or sets the horizontal offset (in points) of the shadow from the specified shape. A positive value offsets the shadow to the right of the shape; a negative value offsets it to the left. Read/write Single.

properties.name: OffsetY
properties.description: Returns or sets the vertical offset (in points) of the shadow from the specified shape. Read/write Single.

properties.name: Transparency
properties.description: Returns or sets the degree of transparency of the specified shadow as a value between 0.0 (opaque) and 1.0 (clear). Read/write Single.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns or sets the shape shadow type. Read/write MsoShadowType.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: True if the specified object, or the formatting applied to it, is visible. Read/write MsoTriState.

properties.name: Style
properties.description: Returns or sets a MsoShadowType that represents the type of shadow formatting to apply to a shape. Read/write.

properties.name: Blur
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the blur level for a shadow format. Read/write.

properties.name: Size
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the width of the shadow. Read/write.

properties.name: RotateWithShape
properties.description: Returns or sets an MsoTriState that represents whether to rotate the shadow when rotating the shape. Read/write.

methods.name: IncrementOffsetX
methods.description: Changes the horizontal offset of the shadow by the specified number of points.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how far the shadow offset is to be moved horizontally, in points. A positive value moves the shadow to the right; a negative value moves it to the left.

methods.name: IncrementOffsetY
methods.description: Changes the vertical offset of the shadow by the specified number of points.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how far the shadow offset is to be moved vertically, in points. A positive value moves the shadow down; a negative value moves it up.
